text.section: A foreign corporation may not transact business in the Commonwealth until it obtains a certificate of authority from the Commission.
The list of activities in subsection B is not exhaustive.

This section does not apply in determining the contacts or activities that may subject a foreign corporation to service of process, taxation, or regulation under the laws of the Commonwealth other than this chapter.
The term "transacting business" as used in this section shall have no effect on personal jurisdiction under § 8.01-328.1.
